_doc: Begin events of the riverside activities (RecreationActivity.launchEventID), fired by Job_Activity when it launches the activity, and again for each latecomer who joins (isLate) - no trigger of their own. SELF ONLY DECIDES VISIBILITY (the player when involved) - use the targets: participants / mandatory / optional / host / one key per invite role (e.g. companion) / waited (there at the launch) / late (the launch: still missing; a late fire: the latecomer) / player. AppendStrings: isLate, hasWaited / hasLate, activityRunning, activityName, instanceKey.

list._comment: recreation_offer_jp_riverside_fireworks - a hostless World session: no mandatory participants, so it launches at T+5 with whoever has gathered on the embankment.

recreation_offer_jp_riverside_stroll - Private: a solo stroll, or with the housemate (role companion) who accepted; launches once everyone attending is at the promenade (at T+30 with whoever is there - nobody is mandatory). Fired again for a latecomer (isLate, late = the latecomer). Uses the targets, never self.

zh-cn.Riverside_Fireworks_Begin_EV01: 河岸上人头攒动。随着一声尖啸，第一发烟火冲上夜空，烟火大会开始了！
zh-cn.Riverside_Stroll_Begin_EV01: $waited.name$沿着河畔步道慢慢走了起来。
zh-cn.Riverside_Stroll_Begin_late: $late.name$来晚了一些，不过还是赶上了，加入了河边的散步。
